name: looking_glass
summary: View Gaussian splats on Looking Glass Go with live holographic output and quilt exports.
description: Windows-only Looking Glass Go viewer with calibrated native display output, Move/Rotate/Scale camera controls, FOV, depthiness, focus, near/far clipping, view filtering and Gaussian sigma. Render on demand or use realtime refresh, then export PNG/JPEG quilts, stationary HEVC MP4 quilts or individual views for Looking Glass Studio 2.0. Requires Looking Glass Bridge, full 64-bit CPython 3.12 and LichtFeld's render_lightfield_view_u8 API, merged in upstream PR #3735. Tested with unpatched upstream master 5397f9047; older hosts without that API need the documented renderer patch.
author: tomhalpin8
